cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this AI and TCR video and the second part of the Reasoning Deep Dive mini-series.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到 C# AI 影片，以及深入推理功能系列的第二部分。

cues.en: In this video, we're going to look at how OpenAI do its reasoning.
cues.zh: 這支影片要看 OpenAI 如何進行推理。

cues.en: If you haven't seen part one, I heartily encourage you to do so before seeing this video.
cues.zh: 如果還沒看第一部分，非常建議先看完再來看這支。

cues.en: So here we are inside the Visual Studio, and over in our sample repo, we have Thinking
cues.zh: 現在在 Visual Studio 中，範例儲存庫裡有 Thinking，

cues.en: and Reasoning settings, and we are running the OpenAI settings here.
cues.zh: 與 Reasoning Settings，這裡執行的是 OpenAI 設定範例。

cues.en: So OpenAI, as mentioned in the first video, was the first one to actually have reasoning models.
cues.zh: 如第一支影片所說，OpenAI 是最早推出推理模型的供應商。

cues.en: And the first one was the O1 model.
cues.zh: 第一個是 o1 模型。

cues.en: You can still hit it in certain areas, but it's kind of a legacy model now.
cues.zh: 某些地方仍然能使用，但現在已算是舊模型。

cues.en: Then they made O3, there was never an O2 because of a legal trade name with the O2 company in the UK.
cues.zh: 接著推出 o3；中間沒有 o2，因為英國 O2 公司的商標問題。

cues.en: So the next one was called O3, and the next one was called O4, there's various mini-models and pro-models of them.
cues.zh: 所以接下來叫 o3，再來是 o4，也有不同的 Mini 與 Pro 版本。

cues.en: But what you really need in models right now is the ChatGPT5.
cues.zh: 但目前真正應該關注的是 GPT-5。

cues.en: So ChatGPT5 was the first model, so for example, the famous 4.0 is not a reasoning model.
cues.zh: GPT-5 系列具有推理能力；相較之下，之前很有名的 GPT-4o 不是推理模型。

cues.en: We should expect that all future models are reasoning models from OpenAI, because this
cues.zh: 可以預期 OpenAI 未來的模型都會朝推理模型發展，因為，

cues.en: is the future, but again, these videos are important because we need to control how much thinking is going on.
cues.zh: 這是未來方向。但這個系列仍然重要，因為必須控制模型花多少時間思考。

cues.en: So in all these samples, I'm going to ask the question, what is the capital of France
cues.zh: 所有範例都會詢問：「法國的首都是哪裡，

cues.en: and how many people live there, with an extra thing for the AI to understand is to answer
cues.zh: 有多少人口？」再加上一個要求，

cues.en: back in max three words.
cues.zh: 最多用三個詞回答。

cues.en: I also do that so it's easier for you to see the output over here.
cues.zh: 這樣也比較容易在畫面上觀察輸出。

cues.en: But what we can do is, if we just take a baseline, and the baseline here, if we go
cues.zh: 先從基準測試開始。看看下方，

cues.en: down and have a look, we can see we're using a ChatGPT5 mini, and we're just asking the
cues.zh: 我們使用 GPT-5 mini，只是單純詢問，

cues.en: question, nothing changed other than just telling, hey, ChatGPT5 mini, answer this question.
cues.zh: 沒有改任何設定，直接要求模型回答這個問題。

cues.en: So this is what I call a baseline, and what many people don't know is that reasoning is on by default on these models, and it's by default medium.
cues.zh: 這就是我所說的基準；很多人不知道，這些模型預設已啟用推理，而且預設強度是 Medium。

cues.en: That might sound okay, but for a simple question like, what's the capital of France and how many people live there, it is probably a bit too much even for that.
cues.zh: 聽起來可能沒問題，但對首都與人口這種簡單問題而言，可能還是思考得太多。

cues.en: So if I just press F10 and let it run the code down here, which is just a normal run
cues.zh: 按 F10 執行下方這段一般呼叫，

cues.en: and then give some output, we will see that it takes quite a while.
cues.zh: 再輸出結果，可以看到等了相當一段時間。

cues.en: So it's still thinking, and it came back.
cues.zh: 它還在思考，現在回覆了。

cues.en: And what we see is it wrote back that Paris is 2.1 million, not the important part in
cues.zh: 答案是巴黎、210 萬人口；這不是這個系列的重點，

cues.en: this video series, but more that we had an input token that's also not too much because
cues.zh: 輸入 Token 也不是重點，因為每次輸入都差不多。

cues.en: it will always be the same input, but we used 528 output tokens, and of those, 512 of them
cues.zh: 但這次使用了 528 個輸出 Token，其中 512 個，

cues.en: were used for reasoning.
cues.zh: 是推理 Token。

cues.en: So if we do the same, but now we're going to do reasoning equals minimal.
cues.zh: 接著做同樣的事，但把推理強度改成 Minimal。

cues.en: And to do equal minimal, we need to do quite a lot of extra here in the raw format because
cues.zh: 要設定 Minimal，使用原生框架時需要這麼多額外程式碼，因為，

cues.en: of this not being a standard yet on how to do reasoning.
cues.zh: 各供應商的推理設定還沒有標準化。

cues.en: So we need to, inside our agent, give the chat client options of going into the chat
cues.zh: 必須在代理程式的 ChatClientAgentOptions 裡進入，

cues.en: options and inside this doing something called raw representation factory.
cues.zh: ChatOptions，再設定 RawRepresentationFactory。

cues.en: And this is an object directly from OpenAI that we need to set and set the reasoning effort to a number.
cues.zh: 它需要一個直接來自 OpenAI 的物件，在裡面指定 ReasoningEffort。

cues.en: And over time, they have made various different versions of this reasoning effort.
cues.zh: 隨著時間過去，推理強度也增加了不同選項。

cues.en: There's actually two more now, one called none, and one called extra high.
cues.zh: 現在其實還有 None 與 ExtraHigh 兩個。

cues.en: Some models support them, but for example, it's only the chativity 5.2 and higher that understand the very high, for example.
cues.zh: 只有部分模型支援，例如 ExtraHigh 要 GPT-5.2 以上才支援。

cues.en: But if we do all this extra step, and to me, this is very cumbersome, and I will also show
cues.zh: 完成這些額外設定後，我覺得這樣很繁瑣，稍後也會示範，

cues.en: how I, in real life, use something on top of agent framework in order to make this easier.
cues.zh: 實務上如何在 Agent Framework 上加一層，讓這件事更簡單。

cues.en: But if we do this and let it run, so if I come up here again, write out the chat and
cues.zh: 不過先執行它，回到上方輸出對話，

cues.en: let the code we just saw run, you'll see it comes back much, much faster because now
cues.zh: 執行剛才的程式，就會看到回覆快得多，因為現在，

cues.en: we had minimal reasoning, gave back the same answer because it's more or less facts that it have.
cues.zh: 只使用 Minimal 推理；答案一樣，因為這主要是它已知的事實。

cues.en: It doesn't need to reason on it.
cues.zh: 不需要額外推理。

cues.en: So imagine you're the user being up here versus the user being down here when it comes to such a simple question like this.
cues.zh: 對這麼簡單的問題，想像一下上方與下方使用者的體驗差異。

cues.en: You would much rather be the user down here because you got a fast answer, and at the
cues.zh: 你一定更希望是下方的使用者，因為很快就得到答案；同時，

cues.en: same time, you much want to be a developer down here because it costs much less tokens.
cues.zh: 開發者也會喜歡這個版本，因為 Token 成本低得多。

cues.en: So controlling reasoning for minimal like this is a good thing, but if it had been a
cues.zh: 因此像這樣適度降低推理強度，是很好的做法；但如果問題，

cues.en: very, very advanced question, of course, we might end up having problems here because
cues.zh: 非常複雜，可能就會發生問題，因為，

cues.en: it couldn't follow the rules or didn't think enough about it.
cues.zh: 模型沒有充分思考，導致沒遵守要求或答錯。

cues.en: If we go on the other hand and go much higher because what we have also seen so far has
cues.zh: 反過來，也可以提高推理強度；而目前為止看到的，

cues.en: only just been the chat client, and when we saw down here, we can only really set one
cues.zh: 都只是 Chat Client。在剛才的設定中，推理相關其實只能調整，

cues.en: thing about this when it comes to reasoning.
cues.zh: 一個選項。

cues.en: There's nothing more that is about reasoning in the chat client.
cues.zh: Chat Client 沒有其他推理相關的設定。

cues.en: But if we go up here and begin to use the responses API, which does it in a slightly different manner as well.
cues.zh: 但如果改用 Responses API，做法又會稍微不同。

cues.en: Here it's a create response, while here it's a chat completion options, making it difficult for you to understand and remember in day-to-day.
cues.zh: 這裡是 CreateResponseOptions，剛才則是 ChatCompletionOptions，所以日常很難記住。

cues.en: Whenever I need to set these things, I always need to go back to a previous sample, hence the reason why I've made something better that I will show in one second.
cues.zh: 每次要設定都得回頭找舊範例，因此我才做了稍後要介紹的簡化版本。

cues.en: But this is the raw way of doing it, and we can now set something called a reasoning options.
cues.zh: 先看原生做法，現在可以設定 ReasoningOptions。

cues.en: And in that, we can set again an effort level from high, extra high, and so on, but we can
cues.zh: 裡面同樣能指定 High、ExtraHigh 等強度，另外還能，

cues.en: also set a reasoning summon verbosity, because whenever something reasons, we might want to see what did it reason about?
cues.zh: 指定推理摘要的詳細程度，因為我們可能想知道它大致思考了什麼，

cues.en: Why did it come to that conclusion?
cues.zh: 以及為什麼得到這個結論。

cues.en: And in the chat client part here, that is not an option, while if we use the responses API, it is an option.
cues.zh: Chat Client 沒有這個功能，但 Responses API 有。

cues.en: In general, OpenAI is a big mess of different settings with different options, and when you begin to...
cues.zh: 整體來說，OpenAI 有許多分散在不同位置的設定；接著……

cues.en: When we see in video two and three on Google and Entropic, we will see that this is kind
cues.zh: 在後面介紹 Google 與 Anthropic 時，會看到，

cues.en: of a big patchwork of different things as they came along.
cues.zh: OpenAI 的設定比較像隨功能增加而逐步拼接起來。

cues.en: They will probably streamline down the road, but here we need to go in and actually go
cues.zh: 未來也許會整合得更一致；目前這裡可以選擇，

cues.en: between auto, concise, and detailed in how much we want to see back.
cues.zh: Auto、Concise 或 Detailed，決定要取得多少摘要內容。

cues.en: And we can see it's a summary, so it will actually think more inside, but we only get
cues.zh: 注意這是摘要，模型內部實際思考得更多，我們取得的，

cues.en: the summaries of what it thought about.
cues.zh: 只是推理過程的摘要。

cues.en: If we go into this example, in this case, I've set the reasoning to high to see how much it thinks, because, again, if you set reasoning to minimal, there will not be a
cues.zh: 這個範例設定 High，方便看它思考了什麼；如果設成 Minimal，通常不會有，

cues.en: lot of reasoning summary back, while if we set it to high, there will be a lot of reasoning summary back.
cues.zh: 太多推理摘要，但 High 就會回傳比較多。

cues.en: So if I let this run, again, it will think a lot, and I'm even using the ChatGP 5 Mini.
cues.zh: 執行後，它又會思考很久，而且我用的還只是 GPT-5 mini。

cues.en: If we use the ChatGP 5, the time we would now sit and wait would be even longer.
cues.zh: 如果使用 GPT-5，等待時間還可能更長。

cues.en: And again, high is higher than the default, which was medium, so this will be the longest time we wait here.
cues.zh: High 也高於預設的 Medium，所以這裡會等最久。

cues.en: So behind the scenes right now, it's doing the internal monologue, and we can see now that it come back, that this is determining the response form.
cues.zh: 模型正在內部推理；回覆後可以看到，它正在考慮答案格式。

cues.en: User wants to have a response of maximum three words, and a lot of things it now thinking about.
cues.zh: 例如使用者要求最多三個詞，以及其他各種條件。

cues.en: So we are getting this data back.
cues.zh: 這些資訊都能取回。

cues.en: I didn't show it, but down here, when we ask the question, we can, inside the messages,
cues.zh: 剛才沒有特別展示，但在回覆訊息中，

cues.en: find the contents that are subtype text reasoning content, and then we can write this out, and this is what we're seeing right now.
cues.zh: 可以找出 TextReasoningContent 型別的 Content，再把它輸出，也就是目前畫面上的內容。

cues.en: So this is not what the user will see, but you could optionally show this or log it or
cues.zh: 這不是最終使用者一定會看到的內容，但你可以選擇顯示、記錄，

cues.en: whatever you wish to do with it in order to understand why did it end up saying Paris 2.1 million.
cues.zh: 或做其他處理，理解它為什麼最後回答巴黎、210 萬人口。

cues.en: And we can see, because of reasoning, we now ended up with 1,472 of the tokens were used for reasoning.
cues.zh: 可以看到，這次有 1,472 個 Token 用於推理。

cues.en: So it took a long time to answer this, and that's because this is a long reasoning effort.
cues.zh: 因此回答花了很久，原因就是設定了較高推理強度。

cues.en: You ask the question, and had it been a human, that human would have sat for perhaps 30 seconds, a minute, before they even answered your question.
cues.zh: 如果換成人類，就像問完問題後，對方先想三十秒到一分鐘才回答。

cues.en: But again, if it's more complex, this is really the way for the LLM to actually get the answer
cues.zh: 但如果問題更複雜，這確實能幫助 LLM，

cues.en: right, at the cost of more tokens and more time.
cues.zh: 得到正確答案，代價就是更多 Token 與時間。

cues.en: Let's move on, because I really, really honestly hate code like this.
cues.zh: 接著繼續，因為我真的很不喜歡這樣的程式碼。

cues.en: It's difficult to remember.
cues.zh: 很難記住，

cues.en: It's annoying to look at.
cues.zh: 看起來也很煩。

cues.en: And in real life, when I sit and do these things, I think, yeah, I should use the ChattyPT5
cues.zh: 實務上，我常常只是想使用 GPT-5，

cues.en: for its intelligence, but I don't need it to reason.
cues.zh: 因為它比較聰明，但不需要它一直推理。

cues.en: So I want to make it quickly go down to minimal, but that's not easy, because I need to sit
cues.zh: 所以想快速切成 Minimal，卻不容易，因為得，

cues.en: and copy-paste this along, and I make helper methods to do it, and so on.
cues.zh: 複製貼上這些設定，或自己寫輔助方法。

cues.en: So I have created what is called the Agent Framework Toolkit.
cues.zh: 因此我建立了 Agent Framework Toolkit。

cues.en: So what we're about to see here is exactly the same as we saw with the raw here, going minimal.
cues.zh: 接下來的程式，會完成和剛才原生 Minimal 範例完全相同的事情。

cues.en: And the Agent Framework Toolkit does it in a much more concise way, in that we just create an agent factory, and then we get an agent.
cues.zh: Toolkit 寫法精簡得多，只要建立 AgentFactory，再建立代理程式。

cues.en: And among the features, just like models and tools and such, is just the reasoning effort directly here.
cues.zh: 在模型、工具等一般選項旁邊，就能直接設定 ReasoningEffort。

cues.en: So this does exactly the same, just in a much more concise manner.
cues.zh: 作用完全相同，只是程式碼簡潔許多。

cues.en: So if we do this, we can see it's fast, not because it's Agent Framework, but because we chose minimal.
cues.zh: 執行後很快就回覆；不是因為用了 Toolkit，而是因為選了 Minimal。

cues.en: And we get back that it's 1.2 million and a low token count.
cues.zh: 這裡回覆 120 萬，Token 用量也很少。

cues.en: And in the same manner, if we want to use Agent Framework Toolkit for responses part,
cues.zh: 同樣地，若要用 Toolkit 操作 Responses API，

cues.en: the only thing we need to tell is it's a client-type of responses and the two settings.
cues.zh: 只要指定 ClientType 為 Responses，再提供這兩項設定。

cues.en: So again, these few lines of code versus all these extra things you need to set in the raw framework.
cues.zh: 這幾行就能取代原生框架需要的一大串額外選項。

cues.en: So if we do that, again, it will be slow to do it, because we are now doing the reasoning,
cues.zh: 執行後一樣比較慢，因為現在有啟用較高強度的推理，

cues.en: and we should roughly end up with the same as we saw in the raw responses API.
cues.zh: 結果也應該與剛才原生 Responses API 大致相同。

cues.en: What you will also see down here is that when we have reasoning, I have a handy method just directly on the response to say, get reasoning content.
cues.zh: 此外，回覆物件上有個方便的方法 GetReasoningContent。

cues.en: So you don't need to write all this part as well.
cues.zh: 因此也不必自己寫剛才那整段擷取程式。

cues.en: This is just tucked away in an extension method.
cues.zh: 只是把它封裝成擴充方法。

cues.en: So if we get back, it will just give us the reasoning, and we can print it out to the
cues.zh: 回覆後，它會直接取得推理內容，可以顯示給，

cues.en: user, save it, and so on.
cues.zh: 使用者、儲存起來，或做其他處理。

cues.en: So Agent Framework Toolkit does not make reasoning better or faster or anything, but it just makes your part of the code much more simple to look at.
cues.zh: Toolkit 不會讓推理更好或更快，只是讓你的程式碼更簡單。

cues.en: So if we look at this part of the code versus the raw version with responses API, we can
cues.zh: 比較這裡與原生 Responses API 的版本，

cues.en: see it can't even fit on half the screen here.
cues.zh: 原本的程式碼甚至放不進半個畫面。

cues.en: So it's just a more convenient way to do it.
cues.zh: 所以只是讓使用更方便。

cues.en: But that's not the important part here.
cues.zh: 但這不是最重要的部分。

cues.en: If you do it one way or the other, the most important thing is go in for the love of God
cues.zh: 不論採取哪種寫法，最重要的是請務必，

cues.en: and help your users not get slow answers just because you've gone to the new model.
cues.zh: 不要只因為換了新模型，就讓使用者被迫等待很慢的答案。

cues.zh: 如果事先知道完全不需要推理，也可以直接用 GPT-4.1，

cues.en: is not a reasoning model, but when it's easy, I tend to stay with five on everything and then controlling the reasoning on the fly.
cues.zh: 它不是推理模型。不過設定方便後，我通常都用 GPT-5，再依需求動態控制推理強度。
